caption: The image shows a ceramic pitcher with a large handle and a spout, displayed on a plain surface. On the side of the pitcher is a detailed, monochrome illustration in black on the otherwise light-colored ceramic. The composition of the illustration is centered around a globe showing the Atlantic Ocean, with the continents of North America, South America, Europe, and Africa labeled. Surrounding the globe are five male figures dressed in period clothing, some standing and some seated, and they appear to be engaged in discussion or presentation. Above the globe is an eagle perched atop a shield with vertical stripes and stars, and an arrangement of flags, cannons, and other symbols. Encircling the central imagery is a border formed by laurel branches. At the bottom of the illustration is a banner with text listing names: "1. Adams, 2. Jay, 3. Franklin." The pitcher is primarily a light, off-white color with the illustration and thin bands on the rim and base in dark ink.
title: Liverpool Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
